short_summary: rows purged before archive; archive failure loses data
summary: The new `db.purge(rows)` call runs before `archive(rows, opts)`, so any failure in archive leaves the rows destroyed with no archived copy.
failure_scenario: closeAccount called for a confirmed user; db.purge deletes the rows; archive(rows, opts) throws (e.g. storage unavailable) → the exception propagates, the account data is gone, and nothing was archived.
